# Rushan Haque

> Rushan Haque is a website developer, designer and writer based in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. He designs and builds custom business websites, online stores, export catalogues and web applications from scratch, for businesses across India and abroad (clients in India, Saudi Arabia, Poland and Nepal), and looks after them after launch.

## Key facts

- Name: Rushan Haque (Rushan Ul Haque)
- Role: Website developer and designer; writer. Specialises in UI/UX design, client relationships and development.
- Based in: Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh 244001, India. Works with clients anywhere, remotely.
- Contact: rushanulhaque@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 76680 47608 · https://cal.com/rushan-haque-emssbo/call
- Languages: English, Hindi, French
- Education: B.Tech, Computer Science (IoT), Moradabad Institute of Technology (2023 — 2027)
- Experience: Project Manager, TechBuzz Ideas (Jul 2026 — Present); UI/UX Developer, TechBuzz Ideas (Apr 2026 — Jul 2026); Merchandiser, A.F. International (Jul 2025 — Jan 2026); Freelance Developer, Independent (2024 — Present)
- Reviews: 9 client reviews, all five stars
- Website: https://www.rushanhaque.in/

## Services

- [E-commerce website development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/ecommerce-website-development): Custom e-commerce website development for Indian businesses — product pages, cart and checkout built for mobile, patchy connections and UPI-first payments.
- [Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.rushanhaque.in/generative-engine-optimization): GEO services — getting your business cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Structured data, answer-shaped content and AI crawler access.
- [Landing page design](https://www.rushanhaque.in/landing-page-design): High-converting landing page design and development for paid campaigns — one page, one action, built to make the traffic you buy pay for itself.
- [SEO services](https://www.rushanhaque.in/seo-services): SEO services for businesses in India — technical SEO, local SEO and on-page work done by the person who builds the site, not sold as a monthly retainer for reports.
- [Web application development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/web-application-development): Custom web application development — internal tools, dashboards and product front-ends built for businesses whose work does not fit off-the-shelf software.
- [Website design and development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-design-development): Custom website design and development for businesses across India. Built from scratch, not from a template — fast, mobile-first and built to rank.
- [Website redesign](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-redesign): Website redesign that starts by diagnosing what is actually costing you — speed, mobile layout, structure or search visibility — instead of restyling and hoping.
- [Website speed optimization](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-speed-optimization): Website speed optimization and Core Web Vitals fixes, measured on real mid-range phones over mobile data — how your visitors actually load the site.
